headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while profit momentum lagged for others.
summary: Overall revenue growth in the sector ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. AI‑related services helped lift margins at HCLTech and TCS, but profit growth was modest for Infosys and negative for Wipro. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlook. Dividend payouts remained stable across most companies.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and TCS crossing the 10% AI revenue threshold.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted modest margin expansion, while others kept guidance unchanged.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies declared or maintained interim dividends, signaling confidence in cash flow despite mixed profit trends.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Profit jumped 21% YoY, driven by strong AI revenue and solid margin expansion.
Consistent double‑digit revenue growth and AI revenue exceeding $3 bn, representing over 10% of total.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance was cut.
Profit fell 1.9% YoY despite revenue growth, and headcount reduction signaled cost pressure.
Profit declined 25% YoY even though revenue grew 30%.
